name: Cloud customer database
asset: Customer records stored in a cloud database
threat: An unauthorized user accesses the database because it is publicly accessible
control: Restrict database access using identity-based permissions and network access rules
residual_risk: A compromised authorized account could still access permitted records

name: Cloud data processing
threat: Unauthorized modification of datasets during cloud processing
control: Use access restrictions and data integrity checks
residual_risk: A compromised privileged account may still modify data

name: Real-time sentiment analysis
asset: Streaming social media sentiment data and analysis results
threat: Unauthorized access to the streaming service through exposed API credentials
residual_risk: Exposed credentials may still allow unauthorized access to the streaming service
